measure: Yen scoring: seven 3-point features, four 1-point features, threshold 3; accepted and declined offer override; all eligible outcomes in denominator.
model: GPT-6 Luna, low reasoning effort; named structured feature answers; literal ghost/recruiter checks; exact normalized-text deduplication only for extraction.

sample.independent_human_validation: Not completed. Results are provisional machine-coded associations; the pilot is an implementation check, not a human accuracy estimate.
sample.scope: English nonempty financially and fiscally linked narratives; USD financial levels; direct RCID-GVKEY links; no national prevalence inference.

preparation.language_model: fastText lid.176.ftz; highest probability language en, nonempty narrative; >=0.8 sensitivity
preparation.financial_assignment: Direct RCID-GVKEY; review posted after previous fiscal end and on/before current fiscal end; first/gap year start one calendar year before fiscal end.
preparation.institutional_ownership_link: Exact CUSIP8; latest ownership snapshot on/before fiscal year end and within 366 days; ambiguous same-date values and shares outside [0,1] excluded.

estimation: Firm and fiscal-year fixed effects; firm-clustered standard errors; one-year-ahead outcomes with explicit consecutive-year links; primary past-information EB, raw-share and full-firm-prior sensitivities.
limits: Provisional automated classifications, independent human validation pending. Observational associations, not verified employer intent or national prevalence.

measurement_details.denominator: All eligible reviews including accepted, declined, and no-offer outcomes; never just no-offer reviews. All scored fields must be observed; missing extraction is unclassified, not non-ghost.

feature_questions.still_listed: Was the posting still live after rejection?
feature_questions.known_fake: Did the candidate suggest insider knowledge that the job would not be filled?
feature_questions.future_role: Was the candidate told the role was for future hiring or would not be filled soon?
feature_questions.no_hiring_intent: Was the candidate told the company was not hiring?
feature_questions.not_real_or_delayed: Does the narrative suggest the job does not exist or is not intended to be filled immediately?
feature_questions.delay: Was there a long communication delay?
feature_questions.generic_questions: Were interview questions generic or unrelated?
feature_questions.scheduling_delay: Was there a long delay in scheduling an interview?
feature_questions.no_follow_up: Was there no reply or other communication after interviews?
feature_questions.clueless_interviewer: Was the interviewer uninformed or disinterested?
feature_questions.mentions_ghosting: Did the candidate use ghost, ghosted, or ghosting?
feature_questions.rounds: How many interview rounds are explicitly reported?
feature_questions.internal_hire: Was the job filled by an internal candidate?

inference_note: Confidence intervals condition on the automated labels. Exact evidence-quote matching is a format check, not a classification accuracy estimate.
geography: English-language interview narratives without an interview-country restriction. Financial statements are USD. U.S. domicile is a sensitivity restriction.
high_tech_note: Explicit selected-SIC industry proxy; not an occupation-skill measure or a claim of a validated high-skill classification.
study_focus: Identification and validation of perceived ghost recruitment; existing financial-outcome regressions are supplementary.

confirmed_benchmark.bibliographic_correction: The supplied manuscript prints the issue-wide page range 2801–3294. INFORMS gives article pages 3133–3141.

dependent_variables: Change in operating income after depreciation
original_future_performance_test.posting_measure: Change in average active postings during the first three months of fiscal t+1 relative to the corresponding months of t, scaled by assets[t], then ranked following the manuscript’s convention
controls: lagged asset-scaled change in capital expenditure

our_proposed_extension.equation: DeltaY[i,t+1] = alpha + beta*P[i,t+3m] + gamma*G[i,t] + delta*P[i,t+3m]*G[i,t] + theta*X[i,t] + industry FE + year FE + error
our_proposed_extension.novel_prediction: delta < 0 if higher perceived ghost intensity weakens the otherwise positive information in postings
our_proposed_extension.information_timing: Ghost intensity uses reviews posted by fiscal year-end t. Raw share primary; past-information smoothing as sensitivity; full-sample priors must not introduce future reviews.
our_proposed_extension.comparison: Establish baseline posting slope first; hold common sample fixed; formally test slope difference rather than comparing separate p-values.
our_proposed_extension.caveat: A negative interaction would be convergent validity, not proof of employer intent or individual posting falsity. A null coefficient on ghost intensity alone is insufficient.

confirmed_benchmark.additional_external_check: Matched hires per posting over six months by company, occupation/role, seniority and location, following the logic described in Revelio’s article; separate common review-source evidence from independent worker-start evidence.
data_needed: Time-stamped active-posting counts and identifiers aligned to the financial firm, including the corresponding three-month windows in adjacent fiscal years
Posting opening/closing dates, occupation/skills and geography for duration and composition checks
Worker position starts for independent hiring-conversion checks
Independent human labels of narratives for classification precision/recall
data_currently_supplied: Annual financial statements and selected analyst/ownership files
not_substitutes: Interview-review counts are not active-posting counts
Compustat net employment change is not gross hiring or departures
A significant or insignificant investment coefficient does not validate ghost-job identification
